title: What Grounding Buys: code and data for separating evidence and citation contracts in language model explanations of a variational quantum model
description: Code, frozen decision logs, per-cell language model caches, and scored records for the study "What Grounding Buys: Separating Evidence and Citation Contracts in Language Model Explanations of a Variational Quantum Model". The archive contains the eight-qubit substrate checkpoint, the routing battery, the frozen 90-cell grid (55,080 records), the evidence by citation-contract grid (18,360 records), the classical control, the post-freeze analyses, and the human annotation sheet for the citation auditor. Every table and figure of the manuscript is regenerated from these files by the scripts in the repository. Code is released under the MIT license and data under CC BY 4.0.
